jobs_results.title: CLOUD BIG DATA ENGINEER - MADRID
jobs_results.description:
Are you opened to new and exciting challenges? TMC is looking for Cloud Big Data Engineers to join our Team in Madrid. Be part of our team whose culture celebrates collaboration, learning, constructive debate, innovation and creativity. Would you like to know more?

| Your challenges?

We are currently seeking flexible and fast-thinking Cloud Big Data Engineers.

Depending on your expertise and affinity, areas of application may include Retail, TELCO, Energy, IOT Distributed Systems, Mobility and Healthcare. The work will mainly be conducted in project teams of various (technical) disciplines. It is crucial that you have a good overview of the possible applications of your expertise and that you’re able to motivate this to others.

As a Cloud Big Data Engineer in our team you will be challenged with:
• Designing and/or building the data model and its complex processing infrastructure that meets the business’s requirements;
• Transforming large, complex data-sets into pragmatic... actionable insights;
• Leveraging data to identify, quantify and realize tangible business gain;
• Having the capacity to thrive in our fast-paced environment, adapting quickly and taking ownership of your work;
• Managing innovative ideas and methods while working together with talented, highly skilled team members.

We focus on delivering quality work, supporting our customers and above all, attitude! That’s why we expect our people to feel at home in all areas of today’s development.

| What do we expect from you?

Perfectly fluent in Spanish, you have a BSc. or MSc. in software engineering, computer science, (theoretical) physics, econometrics, statistics, scientific computing, bioinformatics or comparable background. Degree in Computer Sciences, Informatics or related field required.

During your studies or through professional experience (minimum 3 years of relevant experience is required) you have gained expertise in one or more of the following topics:
• Strong technical skills regarding, data(base) modeling, data warehousing and programming;
• Strong working knowledge of Python, R, Java, Hadoop, Cloudera, Kafka Ecosystem, Snowflake, Spark, Scala-Spark, Flink, Hive, HDFS, Impala, Kudu, API's, SQL, and / or noSQL;
• * Strong working knowledge of Cloud: Azure, Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform.
• Strong working knowledge of designing and implementing common BI applications, such as Tableau, Qlikview, Spotfire, Splunk, SAP, SAS, or others;
• Proven experience and affinity with designing and building of data processing solutions, data storage solutions, cloud solutions, and / or database management;
• Experience with processing large data sets (> 1 TB) is considered a plus;
• Knowledge of Agile methods is considered a plus;

In addition to these technical skills developed through your industry experience, you have developed strong soft skills such as good oral and written communicative skills, stress resistance and a team player attitude. Serious motivation for the Employeneurship model of TMC is also required.

Your profile matches these expectations? Let’s talk about your plan!

| What does our Business Cell have to offer?

Be part of the TMC Software Factory, our Development Center that provides IT expertise and development based on best practices and accumulated experience to all our clients. We excel in agile development and IT engineering.

Who we are?
• High Performance Development Center
• Technological solutions tailored-fit for each customer
• Capability to work with a variety of technologies
• Software quality & security compliance best practices
• Continuous delivery to customers
• Cybersecurity compliance
• We invest in technological surveillance

| What can you expect from TMC?

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to their clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster changing technological world.

At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career.

As an Employeneur you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture.

| Why choose for Employeneurship?

We are truly unique thanks to our Employeneurship model which is a true innovation for the High Technology consulting business. It is the business relationship of the 21th century for high skilled technical professionals. It is built around 5 main pillars:
• You will have a permanent employment contract, offering you stability and security
• You will get to know your market value and have a share in the profit your work generates thanks to the individual profit sharing
• We will support you with a one-on-one coaching and trainings designed to help you develop your entrepreneurial skills
• The competence cells structure, provides you with a strong meaningful and relevant network
• The entrepreneurial lab: a playground for new ideas and a potential launching for start-ups

TMC is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

jobs_results.title: Big Data Engineer (Scala & Spark)
jobs_results.description:
About GFT Group

As a pioneer for digital transformation GFT develops sustainable solutions across new technologies – from cloud engineering and artificial intelligence to blockchain/DLT.

With its deep technological expertise, strong partnerships and comprehensive market know-how GFT offers advice to the financial and insurance sectors, as well as in the manufacturing industry. Through the intelligent use of IT solutions GFT increases productivity and creates added value for clients.

Companies gain easy and safe access to scalable IT-applications and innovative business models. Founded in 1987 and located in more than 15 markets to ensure proximity to clients, the GFT team consists of over 10,000 determined talents. GFT provides them with career opportunities in all areas of software engineering and innovation.

Your mission
• Design, develop, and test data solutions aligned with business needs.
• Research new technologies and algorithms from which you will develop prototypes and... PoC (Proof of Concept).
• Work in a multidisciplinary team, together with Data Scientists, Software Architects, and Developers.
• Provide, on-time, technical support to the sales department.
• Develop analytical tools and programs.
• Develop and process data systems.
• Develop algorithms and prototypes

What they expect from you
• Tech skills they must have:
• Agile methodologies: Scrum
• Previous experience of 2/3 years of experience in Big Data projects with Scala and Spark
• Knowledge of the software development life cycle (data engineering, development, testing, and deployment of data solutions).
• Experience in software development, analysis, and architecture design.
• Experience in data modeling and manipulation
• Knowledge in data transformation or ETL
• Nice to have:
• Google Cloud, AWS or Azure
• Hadoop, Cassandra, Impala, Hive, spark streaming, Kafka, flume, apache Nifi
• Flink (Java) for real-time processing of operations.
• Spring boot for the user application (GUI), and some microservices.
• Elastic and Kibana for visualization and monitoring.
• Soft skills:
• The initiative, flexibility, proactivity, and responsibility
• Communication and negotiation skills
• Organizational skills
• Leadership and team management

Benefits & perks
• Conciliation and Flexibility: Possibility of working from home hybrid/remote, flexible working days and intensive Fridays.
• Training and Development: Personalized plan, training programs.
• Social Benefits: Meal vouchers, life insurance, telecommuting support.
• Flexible Remuneration: Adjusted to your needs (health insurance, childcare, training, others).
• Relocation Package (if applicable): Financial support, counseling, visa sponsorship.
• Referral Program.
• Wellness Program: Nutrition, Physical, Mental. Discounts with Gympass.
• Life at GFT: Smart offices, events, value allowances, inspirational talks.
• International corporate culture

Somos una empresa dedicada al Marketing y Publicidad Directa e impresión electrónica, situada en Alcobendas (Madrid), siendo nuestra visión empresarial la Transformación Digital.

Para ello necesitamos un experto en Programación Big Data para proveer a la organización de los conocimientos, habilidades y actitudes necesarios para conseguir dicho fin.
DESCRIPCION PUESTO DE TRABAJO Es el responsable de los datos empresariales y de la estrategia de la información. Debe diseñar, implantar y optimizar una estrategia a largo plazo del manejo de la información en la empresa. Tareas Administración de sistemas de almacenamiento distribuido.

Realización de un análisis del entorno y diseño de un sistema de reporting para la visualización de los datos, principalmente en la materia de business intelligence.
Desarrollo de consultas con bases de datos utilizando SQL o PL/SQL. Utilización de herramientas como, Hadoop, Hive o Pig. Desarrollo de programas estadísticos, preferent #J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Big Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We know people

Who we are?

KITRUM is a one-stop custom software development company headquartered in sunny Florida with development centers in Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Israel, and Poland. With a pool of 300+ top-notch engineering resources, we help CxOs of VC-backed startups and fast-growing tech companies in the US, EU and Australia to custom build software engineering teams packed with top-tier talent.

We Realize That One Of The Most Crucial Things For Developers — Adequate Client And Fascinating Projects. So We Qualify Our Clients To Make Sure That They

— have an idea that they believe will make the world a better place;

— think long-term and looking for a trusted-tech partner;

— want to rely on and avoid micromanaging;

— are not f$%$ing jackasses :-)

Follow our team on Instagram to know more about our daily life instagram.com/kitrum.team :)

We adore making new friends on the board!

The Role

Your Responsibilities Will Include
• Manage data quality and integrity
• Assist with... building tools and technology to ensure that downstream customers can have faith in the data they’re consuming
• Cross-functional work with the Data Science or Content Engineering teams to troubleshoot, process, or optimize business-critical pipelines
• Work with Core Platform to implement better processing jobs for scaling the consumption of streaming data sets

Ideal Profile
• 5+ years of experience in data engineering creating or managing end-to-end data pipelines on large complex datasets.
• Experience in developing scalable software using big data technologies (e.g. Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Flink, Samza, Storm, Elasticsearch, Druid, Cassandra, etc).
• Expertise in Scala
• Fluency with at least one dialect of SQL
• Level of English: Upper-Intermediate
• Experience with Streaming platforms, typically based around Kafka
• Strong grasp of AWS data platform services and their strengths/weaknesses
• Strong experience using Jira, Slack, JetBrains IDEs, Git, GitLab, GitHub, Docker, Jenkins, Terraform
• Experience using DataBricks

What's on Offer?
• Work within a company with a solid track record of success
• Flexible working options
• Great work environment
• High compensation according to your technical skills
• Democratic management style & friendly environment
• Professional and personal growth

jobs_results.title: Big Data Support Engineer
jobs_results.description:
[INT] MAL-CDI-85 | Big Data Support Engineer

Description

Position title: Big Data Support Engineer

Area: CoE Big Data & Cloud

Location: Málaga , Spain

Mode : Hybrid (onsite 2 days per week)

Type : Contract

What You Will Do In Your Job

As a Big Data Support Engineer, you will be part of the team responsible for the production and maintenance of SCIB applications developed under both Cloud and Cloud infrastructure at Databricks. Our Support team aims to ensure an optimal service, for this we perform the following tasks:
• User support (incidents and requests).
• SCIB application support.
• Adaptive support.
• Corrective support.
• Preventive support.

Experience
• Experience in CIB, Capital market, Cash, Receivable, FX.
• Experience in resolving incidents in production environments.
• Experience in Cloud services (Azure and AWS).
• Experience with Control_M and Airflow.
• Experience with Data platforms: Databricks, Cloudera, Snowflake, HUE.
• Experience with Data Framework... Spark or pySpark, Hadoop.
• Experience with Data Storage: Hadoop, S3, Parquet.
• Experience with DB query languages: SQL.
• Experience with modelling languages: Phyton, R.
• Experience with functional languages: Scala.
• Experience with object-oriented languages: Scala, Phyton, C++, Java.
• Experience with data mining tools: PowerBI, SAS.
• Experience with Unix environments.
• Experience in remote environments: Mobaxterm, Putty.
• Experience in collaborative environments with devops tools: ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence, Git, Jenkins, UrbanCode.

EDUCATION
• Degree/master's degree in computer engineering, mathematics, physics, telecommunications or similar.
• Desirable Master's degree in Big Data.
• Desirable Machine Learning: neural network models, deep learning, clustering, time series.

LANGUAGES
• English B2

Skills & Knowledge
• Team work
• Leadership
• Communicative
• Proactive
• Autonomous
• Resolute
